draft_text: Ferrule generally achieved a higher test AUROC than Arbor-GBT across the six-dataset tabular suite.
revised_text: Ferrule achieved a higher test AUROC than Arbor-GBT on five of the six datasets in the tabular suite, while Arbor-GBT was higher on Ivel-Fraud.
rationale: T1 shows Ferrule higher on 5 of 6 datasets (r1,r2,r4,r5,r6) but lower on r3 (Ivel-Fraud, 92.3 vs 92.8). "Generally" is defensible, but the claim omits the one dataset where Arbor-GBT was higher; a more precise statement should note the exception. No statistical tests reported, so no significance claim.
